scenario_title: Secrets Manager rotation with cached credentials
title: Authentication failures on billing-svc
impact: Users were logged out or rejected on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-05-25 07:24-11:24: billing-svc: 229 of 323 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-25 07:24 and 2026-05-25 11:24 UTC (peak error ratio 0.9 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.repo.InvoiceRepository - org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: password authentication failed for user "billing_app"
c.f.b.repo.InvoiceRepository - call to billing-db failed: FATAL: password authentication failed for user "billing_app"
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Terraform change enabled automatic rotation of the billing-db credentials; rotation ran at once and billing-svc kept using its cached password (db.credentials_cache_s), so logins failed.
_templates.remediation: Restart billing-svc tasks to pick up the new secret; lower db.credentials_cache_s and refresh on authentication failure before re-enabling rotation.
